notes.title: Tree of Life Speed Run Competition - Win $75
notes.content:
We’re pleased to announce the Last Dream: World Unknown "Tree of Life Speed Run" Competition. Players will be ranked on the quickest time to reach the Necht Tree of Life in Last Dream: World Unknown. The competition ends August 31st, 2017.

[b][u]Key Details: “New Game” or “New Game +” Only, Hard Difficulty, Saving in Designated Locations.[/u][/b]

1st Place Rewards: [b]$75[/b], Last Dream: World Unknown NPC with personalized text, a World Unknown Tombstone, an extra World Unknown Steam Key for a friend, and a statue in the Hall of Champions in World Unknown.

2nd Place Rewards: [b]$50[/b], Last Dream: World Unknown NPC and Tombstone, plus an extra World Unknown Steam Key for a friend.

3rd Place Rewards: [b]$25[/b], Last Dream: World Unknown NPC and an extra World Unknown Steam Key for a friend.

4th Place Rewards: Last Dream: World Unknown NPC and an extra World Unknown Steam Key for a friend.

5th Place Rewards: An extra World Unknown Steam Key for a friend.

*At your option, the extra World Unknown Steam Key can be replaced with a Steam Key for Last Dream II; however, Last Dream II will likely not be ready for release for at least two years.

[b]Official Contest Rules for the Last Dream "Tree of Life Speed Run" Competition[/b]

Participants shall submit a save file with the quickest time to reach the Necht Tree of Life in Last Dream: World Unknown (also termed herein “World Unknown”) prior to August 31st at 11:59 pm pm EDT. 

[b]"Reaching the Necht Tree of Life" Definition:[/b]

Players will be defined to have reached the Necht Tree of Life in Last Dream: World Unknown when they have saved their game using the “Save” option at the Tree of Life in the Town of Necht. After saving, players [b]MUST[/b] save their game and send it to info@whitegiantrpg.com. 

[b]Gameplay Rules:[/b]

• Difficulty level MUST be set to [b]"Hard"[/b]
• Saving option MUST be set to [b]"Saving in Designated Locations"[/b]
• [b][u]Altered "Game Options" (e.g. difficulty, saving options, etc.) are prohibited.[/u][/b]
• "Reborn", “Continue Reborn”, and “Continue” games are prohibited. 
• “Fast Forward” is allowable. (Fast Forward also accelerates the in-game timer).
• Either “Recommended” or “Complete” Skill Access is allowed.
• Any encounter rate is allowable.
• The "New Game +" feature may be utilized. 
• Any party combination 
• All competitors must use the default or demo Steam version of Last Dream: World Unknown. 

[b]Contest Sponsors and Promoters:[/b]

White Giant RPG Studios, LLC 

• Andrew Walker – 597 Myrtle St., Los Alamos, NM 87544 
• Josh Mellon – 66 High Country Rd., Weaverville, NC 28787 
• Mark Cope – 7000 SW Vermont St, Portland, OR 97223 
• Chris Moore – 4224 Packaway Rd, Albuquerque, NM 87114
• Seth Hetu – 660 Cambridge St, #401, Cambridge, MA 02141-1193

[b]Maximum Cost to Participants:[/b] None. 

[b]Special Eligibility Requirements:[/b] None. Players may compete using the freely available Last Dream: World Unknown Demo on Steam. 

[b]Competition Judges:[/b] Andrew Walker, Josh Mellon, Mark Cope, Chris Moore, and Seth Hetu (the Creators of Last Dream) will use submitted save files to objectively determine the quickest time to reach the Necht Tree of Life in Last Dream: World Unknown. 

[b]Selection of a Winner:[/b] All Last Dream: World Unknown save files submitted prior to 11:59 EDT on August 31st to info@whitegiantrpg.com will be analyzed for the quickest time to reach the Tree of Life in Necht in Last Dream: World Unknown. Any save files that do not meet the criteria above will be disqualified, and the remaining entries will be ordered from shortest to longest time to reach the Necht Tree of Life in Last Dream: World Unknown. The five participants with the quickest time to reach the Necht Tree of Life in Last Dream: World Unknown will be awarded prizes. If multiple participants reach the Necht Tree of Life in Last Dream: World Unknown in the same time (to the second), then the participant with the fewest steps will win the tie-breaker. 

[b]Competition Prizes:[/b]

1st Place Rewards: [b]$75[/b], Last Dream: World Unknown NPC with personalized text, a World Unknown Tombstone, an extra World Unknown Steam Key for a friend, and a statue in the Hall of Champions in World Unknown.

2nd Place Rewards: [b]$50[/b], Last Dream: World Unknown NPC and Tombstone, plus an extra World Unknown Steam Key for a friend.

3rd Place Rewards: [b]$25[/b], Last Dream: World Unknown NPC and an extra World Unknown Steam Key for a friend.

4th Place Rewards: Last Dream: World Unknown NPC and an extra World Unknown Steam Key for a friend.

5th Place Rewards: An extra World Unknown Steam Key for a friend.

*At the option of the competition winners, the extra World Unknown Steam Key may be replaced with a Steam Key for Last Dream II with a materially-delayed award date of at least two years and the risk that Steam will not host Last Dream II. In all cases, a Steam Key for World Unknown shall be deemed adequate and full consideration for all competition winners as a replacement for Last Dream II.

Payments will be made via PayPal. Non-cash value prizes are not redeemable for cash. 

[b]Prize Details:[/b]

•The "Last Dream: World Unknown NPC" prize allows the prize winner to have an NPC named after themselves (or any other name of their choice, within the developers’ discretion) in World Unknown. Prize winners will be contacted for information at the conclusion of the competition. 

•The "Last Dream: World Unknown Tombstone" prize allows the prize winner to have a Tombstone with text of their choosing (within the developers’ discretion) in World Unknown. Prize winners will be contacted for information at the conclusion of the competition. 

•The "Last Dream: World Unknown NPC with personalized text" prize allows the prize winner to have an NPC named after themselves or any name of their choice and write text of their choosing (within the developers’ discretion) in World Unknown. Prize winners will be contacted for information at the conclusion of the competition. 

•The "Statue in the Hall of Champions in World Unknown" prize allows the prize winner to have a statue based on a character costume of their choice in a secret location in Last Dream: World Unknown called the Hall of Champions. The statue will also include a plaque with the prize winner’s preferred name and quote. Prize winners will be contacted for information at the conclusion of the competition.

•If selected, Last Dream II will be distributed to prize winners when/if the game is released on Steam.

•If selected, the “World Unknown Steam Key: will be distributed to prize winners within 15 days.

[b]Other Rules:[/b]

[b]Geographic Area of Competition:[/b] Residents of all countries worldwide and of all states in the U.S. are allowed to participate in this competition. This contest is void where prohibited. Contests and promotions are subject to all country, federal, state, and local laws. 

[b]Start and End Dates of Competition:[/b] The competition begins June 1st, 2017 at 12:00 PM EDT and ends at 11:59 PM EDT on August 31st, 2017. Save files received after 11:59 PM EST on August 31st will not be considered. 

[b]Winners Documentation:[/b] The Prize Winners for the competition can be obtained from the Last Dream: World Unknown Community Hub on Steam on September 3rd by 11:59 PM EST. 

[b]Excluded Participants:[/b] Last Dream: World Unknown Creators (Andrew Walker, Josh Mellon, Mark Cope, Chris Moore, Seth Hetu) are excluded from participation in the competition, as well as anyone younger than 13 years of age. 

[b]General Release of Liability:[/b] Contest winners and participants agree to defend, indemnify, release and hold White Giant RPG Studios, LLC and the Last Dream: World Unknown Creators harmless against any and all claims or liability arising directly or indirectly from the prizes or participation in the contest. 

[b]Agreement to Rules:[/b] By submitting a save file to info@whitegiantrpg.com you acknowledge that you are fully aware of and agree with all the terms and conditions of this competition, per the Official Contest Rules for the Last Dream "Tree of Life Speed Run" Competition. 

[b]Other Conditions:[/b] By participating in the contest, a participant agrees to have his or her name, avatar, or likeness used in any advertising or broadcasting material relating to this contest without additional financial or other compensation. 

White Giant RPG Studios, LLC reserves the right to end this contest or amend these rules at any time, for any reason.
